codeComment.comment: Accounting-split F1 — the 44th bundle; gates the standalone accounting module (`/accounting` FE route group + `ANY /api/accounting/{path}` BFF proxy). Cross-repo contract: the FE `Permission` union carries this exact string, so renaming it silently shuts the route gate.

plain.headline: New permission: Accounting — Page Access
plain.what: A new permission called “Accounting — Page Access” was added. It is switched on automatically for: Admin.
plain.why: People with these roles get new access as soon as they move to this release.
check: Open a role in Administration › Roles and Permissions and check “Accounting — Page Access” is listed, in the right section, with the right name.
Log in as someone whose role has “Accounting — Page Access” and try it: it should work.
Log in as someone whose role does not have it and try it: it should be blocked, and the button or page should not be shown.
Check it is switched on for Admin, and off for every other role.

changes.title: Permission added: Work Orders — Receive Later
changes.after: exists; default ON for no system role
changes.risk_reason: New permission, OFF for every system role — no one gains access until a shop grants it.

codeComment.comment: SV-8683 Phase 5 / FR-050 — the "Received later" role-editor checkbox. The 44th bundle. OFF by default in EVERY role: no entry in RoleFePermissionMappings carries it, so no default role's resolved atom set changes and IntentionalAtomChanges needs no ADDED_BY_DESIGN whitelist entry. It is the only thing standing between a user and bypassing the vendor-bill requirement (plan §9), so it must be granted deliberately.

changes.risk_reason: The endpoint now checks something different.

plain.headline: Creating or running technician tasks › check out: the permission check changed

Log in as someone whose role has none of them and try it: it should be blocked, and the button or page should not be shown.

qa_scenarios: API authorisation: call POST /api/technician-tasks/check-out as a role WITH and a role WITHOUT "Invoicing & Payments — Create & Edit" — expect 2xx and 403.

Cross-role: try the same call as each system role whose defaults include or exclude the permission.
